goal: Wave 1 build: Shared stream cancel and durable-cancel fan-out; Thresholds, signed-manifest gate and CI wiring; Stack-free browser-fixture job and bundle budget; Control Prometheus rules for existing metrics; ADR, canonical encoding library, audit-core CI; Enforce and delete (code half)

slices.title: Shared stream cancel and durable-cancel fan-out
slices.summary: A Stop on a replica that does not own the stream reaches the owner over the bus: each cancel-registry entry holds a remote listener on the per-request and per-run cancel subjects, and invoke_cancel and cancel_run answer 202 peer, 404 no owner, or 503 run_control_unavailable. Per K1-7 this slice lands the run-keyed cancel subject with a no-op loop observer; WS03-S3 plugs the observation point later and does not gate this slice.
test_commands: cd 'apps/Model Plane/rust' && cargo test -q -p model-gateway --test run_control_two_replica_test
slices.flag: MODEL_GATEWAY_RUN_CONTROL_BUS (same switch as S1; off means no listener and no bus traffic)

decisions_defaults.DEC-07: (a) NATS request/reply to owner, no message content stored; local hit wins, bus error = 503 `run_control_unavailable` (retryable), never fake 202/404; `/readyz` reports `run_control`. Keep code order (enqueue first) through S3, record ledger correction; reorde

slices.notes: ALSO (handed over from WS04-S1, which does not own http_routes.rs): make the /readyz handler report the run-control bus state: include run_control = state.run_control.status().as_str() (off, ok or degraded) in the answer, HTTP 200 while degraded, and update the readyz tests beside it.

slices.title: Thresholds, signed-manifest gate and CI wiring
slices.summary: Adds proposed acceptance thresholds for gateway error and latency, canary window, audit outbox terminal rows, audit delivery lag, ZDR days to review and rehearsal age; replaces the conformance script's markdown grep with signed-artifact verification and rehearsal evidence under --profile runtime or full, with expiring waivers; adds model-plane-ops-gates.yml with release-gates and session-core-audit-db jobs, and wires the three release-*.sh test scripts into the release-gates job (K1-22). The go-audit and promtool jobs are dropped (K2-8, K2-14) because WS06-S1 runs them.
test_commands: bash 'scripts/coresystem-conformance.sh' --json --profile runtime (must name only real gaps)

slices.title: Control Prometheus rules for existing metrics
slices.summary: Adds audit-core alert rules for metrics that already exist (authority mismatch, store error, malformed, consumer pending above zero for 15 m, NATS disconnected for 5 m) in a new rules file with its promtool unit test. The rule_files glob and the rules mount already landed in 2f8b8caa, so S0 adds only the two new files and must not add a second rule_files key.
test_commands: docker run --rm --entrypoint promtool -v "$PWD/apps/Control Plane/observability:/o" prom/prometheus:v2.54.1 check rules /o/rules/audit-core.rules.yml
